name: Eiken Kikaku
source:
Main character heads Film Research Department and dreams of becoming a movie director. The club is under threat of dissolving with only one member remaining and lacking any success. The only chance for the club to persist is to win prestigious Sakai Film Festival first prize in two months and eliminate criticism from student council. Protagonist is going to coerce student council president with any methods required.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-june-2005-ayakashibito.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公是电影研究部部长，梦想成为电影导演。然而社团只剩一名成员，也没有取得任何成绩，正面临解散危机。若想让社团继续存在，唯一机会是在两个月后的著名堺电影节上夺得一等奖，借此平息学生会的批评。主人公准备不择手段地胁迫学生会长。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-june-2005-ayakashibito.html]vndbreview[/url]]
